bio.text: Nancy Lacore, a retired Navy vice admiral, is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District in 2026; it is her first run for elected office.
She spent 35 years in the Navy, retiring in December 2025, and led about 59,000 sailors as chief of the Navy Reserve, a position she took over in August 2024.
Lacore is a native of Albany, New York. She was deployed as a reservist to Afghanistan in 2011 and to Djibouti in 2017, and she and her husband moved to Mount Pleasant in October 2025.

sources.title: Former Navy Reserve chief announces bid for SC's 1st District
